title: MoTIF-X: A Multimodal Tokenized Framework for Interpretable and Extensible Molecular Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.37384v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Molecular representation learning is central to computer-aided drug discovery. Molecular graphs, SMILES strings, and 3D conformations provide complementary structural information, yet many multimodal approaches encode these views independently and align them only at a later stage, limiting fine-grained cross-modal interaction and substructure-level interpretability. To address these limitations, we introduce MoTIF-X, a motif-centered framework that uses graph-grounded chemical motifs as shared anchors for multimodal integration and interpretation. Its first pretraining stage learns motif representations through hierarchical contrastive learning across atomic, motif, and molecular scales. The second stage contextualizes these representations with SMILES and torsion-angle tokens through multimodal masked token modeling. translated_title: MoTIF-X：一个用于可解释且可扩展的分子表示学习的多模态分词框架
translated_abstract: 分子表示学习是计算机辅助药物发现的核心。分子图、SMILES字符串和三维构象提供了互补的结构信息，然而许多多模态方法对这些视图进行独立编码，仅在后期阶段进行对齐，这限制了细粒度的跨模态交互和子结构层面的可解释性。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了MoTIF-X，这是一个以基序（motif）为中心的框架，它使用基于图的化学基序作为多模态整合与解释的共享锚点。其第一个预训练阶段通过跨原子、基序和分子尺度的分层对比学习来学习基序表示。第二个阶段通过多模态掩码词元建模，将这些表示与SMILES和二面角词元进行上下文化结合。在具有多种构象的类药分子上进行预训练后，MoTIF-X在……上取得了最低的平均绝对误差（摘要内容在此处被截断）。
tldr: MoTIF-X提出了一种以化学基序为共享锚点的多模态分词框架，通过跨原子、基序和分子尺度的分层对比学习与多模态掩码词元建模，整合分子图、SMILES和3D构象信息，实现了可解释且可扩展的分子表示学习。
en_tdlr: MoTIF-X is a motif-centered multimodal tokenized framework that uses graph-grounded chemical motifs as shared anchors, combining hierarchical contrastive learning with multimodal masked token modeling to integrate molecular graphs, SMILES, and 3D conformations for interpretable and extensible molecular representation learning.
